fusions.name: Unshaped Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out an arm of raw arcana that deals 35 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Raw Wash
fusions.desc: Washes a cone of raw arcana 5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Through the Suckers
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bending Light
fusions.desc: Your arcane attacks ignore 25% of the target's armour.
